column1: # sz: the size of a type from its outer constructor and the size of what it holds (OP:INNER; int alone is 4).  A
# pointer is 8 whatever it points to, an array of 3 is three times its element, a function is incomplete (inc).  The
# domain lists exactly the OP:INNER pairs of valid descriptors of depth 1..3 (an array never holds a function, a
# function never holds an array), so every key is one the derivation asks.
